title: Show HN: WhatsApp MCP running free on Cloudflare
summary: A free, serverless WhatsApp MCP server that runs on Cloudflare Workers, enabling AI assistants like Claude to access personal WhatsApp messages without requiring WhatsApp Business API or self-hosted infrastructure. It integrates with Google Contacts to resolve phone numbers to readable contact names.
problem_solved: Enables personal WhatsApp access for AI assistants without paid Business API or maintaining a dedicated server.
why_valuable: Provides a completely free, serverless solution for integrating WhatsApp with AI agents, making mobile AI assistance practical for individual users.
